funding.name: NE Career Scholarship at Community Colleges
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: Renewable scholarship for tuition, fees, required tools and equipment, room and board for degree programs leading to high-wage, high-skill, high-demand careers.
funding.amount: Up to $15,000 per year, per the page.

funding.name: NE Career Scholarship at Private Colleges
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: Renewable scholarship at participating private colleges for tuition, fees, required tools and equipment, room and board for high-wage, high-skill, high-demand programs.
funding.amount: Up to $10,000 per year, per the page.

funding.name: Nebraska Opportunity Grant (NOG)
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: State grant for students who meet qualifications, awarded through participating Nebraska postsecondary institutions.
funding.eligibility: Nebraska resident attending a Nebraska postsecondary institution with a minimum Student Aid Index from the FAFSA.
funding.how_to_apply: Apply to the school, which considers the student for the grant.

funding.name: Door to College (DTC) Scholarship Program
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: Scholarship toward educational expenses for undergraduates at Nebraska postsecondary institutions who graduated from a YRTC or an approved high school, or earned a GED after YRTC discharge.
funding.eligibility: Graduated from a Youth Rehabilitation and Treatment Center, an approved or accredited high school, or earned a GED after YRTC discharge.
funding.amount: Up to $5,000 per year, per the page.

funding.name: Access College Early (ACE) Scholarship Program
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: Pays tuition and mandatory fees for qualified low-income high school students taking college courses through dual or early enrollment agreements.
funding.eligibility: Qualified low-income high school students, per the page.
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the ACE Student Application, reviewed by the Coordinating Commission.

funding.name: Nebraska Career-Readiness and Dual-Credit Education (CRDC) Grant
funding.provider: Nebraska Coordinating Commission for Postsecondary Education
funding.provides: Grants covering tuition and fees for teachers pursuing coursework to teach dual-credit and career and technical education courses.

funding.name: Nebraska Workforce Development Grant Program
funding.provides: Commissioner of Labor awards grants for projects supporting Nebraska workforce development; the Nebraska Workforce Development Board accepts proposals and forwards selections.
funding.how_to_apply: Proposals go through the Nebraska Workforce Development Board, per the page.

funding.name: Nebraska Registered Apprenticeship (employer resources)
funding.provides: Registered apprenticeship combining supervised on-the-job training with classroom instruction; the Good Life, Great Careers goal is 6,000 new registered active apprentices by December 31, 2030.

funding.name: Nebraska Trade Adjustment Assistance (TAA)
funding.provides: Trade Act programs (TAA, RTAA, ATAA) help individuals who became unemployed from increased imports or production shifts return to suitable employment.
funding.eligibility: Individuals unemployed as a result of increased imports or shifts in production to foreign countries, per the page.
